# Browser dependencies

These pinned, unmodified builds are served locally so the portal does not wait for a public CDN on slow or restricted networks.

- htmx 1.9.12 (`htmx.org` npm package): BSD-2-Clause, https://github.com/bigskysoftware/htmx/blob/v1.9.12/LICENSE
- Alpine.js 3.14.1 (`alpinejs` npm package): MIT, https://github.com/alpinejs/alpine/blob/v3.14.1/LICENSE.md
- Lucide 0.468.0 (`lucide` npm package): ISC with Feather portions under MIT; see `LUCIDE-LICENSE.txt`.

Update versions together with the template references and test the login and authenticated portal pages before deployment.
